title: Wall Street is expecting big numbers in today’s AAPL Q1 earnings call
text:
Home » Wall Street is expecting big numbers in today’s AAPL Q1 earnings call Wall Street is expecting big numbers in today’s AAPL Q1 earnings call   
Apple is due to announce its fiscal Q1 2018 (calendar Q4 2017) earnings today, and despite all the doom -and- gloom stories of late, Wall Street is expecting big numbers. In its previous earnings call , Apple gave an unusually wide guidance range for its Q1 revenue. The company has generally narrowed it to a range of $2B, but uncertainty over iPhone X sales is the the likely explanation for the $3B span this time around …
